wiki.title: Robin L. Webb
wiki.extract: Robin Lynn Webb (born September 6, 1960) is an American politician who is a member of the Kentucky Senate. Initially elected in 2009 as a Democratic candidate, she became a Republican on May 30, 2025. She represents the 18th district, which includes Boyd, Carter, Greenup, and Lewis Counties. At the time of her party switch, she was the last remaining Democratic senator to represent a district which had voted for a Republican candidate for president.
